title: A positive resolution of De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight

abstractEnglish: We resolve De Giorgi's conjecture positively in dimension eight: every entire C2 solution $`u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)`$ of $`\Delta u=u^3-u`$ with an everywhere positive directional derivative is a planar heteroclinic. We prove that every stable solution $`v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]`$ of this equation is a constant well or a planar heteroclinic, without an energy-growth assumption.

details.overview: 稿件研究Allen-Cahn型方程Δu=u^3-u在整个空间上的解。作者声称在八维情形正面解决De Giorgi猜想：若u:ℝ^8→(-1,1)为C²解且某方向导数处处为正，则u为平面异宿解；并证明ℝ^7上该方程的所有稳定解为常数井或平面异宿解，无需能量增长假设。该结果若成立将推进De Giorgi猜想的维数边界，但属AI产生手稿，未经独立审查。
